title: "Summary"

::: {.passage}
From *God Passes By*, chapter VIII — "Bahá'u'lláh's Banishment to ʻIráq (Continued)."

> Foremost among the priceless treasures cast forth from the billowing ocean of Bahá'u'lláh's
> Revelation ranks the Kitáb-i-Íqán (Book of Certitude), revealed within the space of two days
> and two nights, in the closing years of that period (1278 A.H.–1862 A.D.). It was written in
> fulfillment of the prophecy of the Báb, Who had specifically stated that the Promised One would
> complete the text of the unfinished Persian Bayán, and in reply to the questions addressed to
> Bahá'u'lláh by the as yet unconverted maternal uncle of the Báb, Ḥájí Mírzá Siyyid Muḥammad,
> while on a visit, with his brother, Ḥájí Mírzá Ḥasan-ʻAlí, to Karbilá. A model of Persian prose,
> of a style at once original, chaste and vigorous, and remarkably lucid, both cogent in argument
> and matchless in its irresistible eloquence, this Book, setting forth in outline the Grand
> Redemptive Scheme of God, occupies a position unequalled by any work in the entire range of
> Bahá'í literature, except the Kitáb-i-Aqdas, Bahá'u'lláh's Most Holy Book. Revealed on the eve
> of the declaration of His Mission, it proffered to mankind the "Choice Sealed Wine," whose seal
> is of "musk," and broke the "seals" of the "Book" referred to by Daniel, and disclosed the
> meaning of the "words" destined to remain "closed up" till the "time of the end."

> Within a compass of two hundred pages it proclaims unequivocally the existence and oneness of a
> personal God, unknowable, inaccessible, the source of all Revelation, eternal, omniscient,
> omnipresent and almighty; asserts the relativity of religious truth and the continuity of Divine
> Revelation; affirms the unity of the Prophets, the universality of their Message, the identity
> of their fundamental teachings, the sanctity of their scriptures, and the twofold character of
> their stations; denounces the blindness and perversity of the divines and doctors of every age;
> cites and elucidates the allegorical passages of the New Testament, the abstruse verses of the
> Qur'án, and the cryptic Muḥammadan traditions which have bred those age-long misunderstandings,
> doubts and animosities that have sundered and kept apart the followers of the world's leading
> religious systems; enumerates the essential prerequisites for the attainment by every true
> seeker of the object of his quest; demonstrates the validity, the sublimity and significance of
> the Báb's Revelation; acclaims the heroism and detachment of His disciples; foreshadows, and
> prophesies the world-wide triumph of the Revelation promised to the people of the Bayán; upholds
> the purity and innocence of the Virgin Mary; glorifies the Imáms of the Faith of Muḥammad;
> celebrates the martyrdom, and lauds the spiritual sovereignty, of the Imám Ḥusayn; unfolds the
> meaning of such symbolic terms as "Return," "Resurrection," "Seal of the Prophets" and "Day of
> Judgment"; adumbrates and distinguishes between the three stages of Divine Revelation; and
> expatiates, in glowing terms, upon the glories and wonders of the "City of God," renewed, at
> fixed intervals, by the dispensation of Providence, for the guidance, the benefit and salvation
> of all mankind. Well may it be claimed that of all the books revealed by the Author of the
> Bahá'í Revelation, this Book alone, by sweeping away the age-long barriers that have so
> insurmountably separated the great religions of the world, has laid down a broad and unassailable
> foundation for the complete and permanent reconciliation of their followers.
:::

Read this passage on [bahai.org](https://www.bahai.org/r/656662496).

## A sequential outline of the text

::: {.lead .lead-sm}
The subjects of the Book of Certitude in the order they appear, as an aid to finding your way
around it. Each number links to that paragraph on the [Read](read.qmd) page. The headings are a
reading aid written for this study, not part of the text, and an outline like this can only follow
one thread at a time through themes the Book weaves together. Hooper Dunbar's
[*Companion to the Study of the Kitáb-i-Íqán*](https://www.bahaibookstore.com/Companion-to-the-Study-of-the-Kitab-i-Iqan-P7228)
includes a fuller outline of its own, and he suggests that students make their own as well.
:::

<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">The Qá&#x27;im&#x27;s sovereignty is real but not as people imagine</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p113">113</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Sovereignty as spiritual ascendancy, revealed according to capacity</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p114">114</a></div>

<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Muḥammad&#x27;s later earthly sovereignty as confirmation</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p117">117</a></div>

<div class="ol-row ol-l1"><span class="ol-text">Resurrection and judgment in Muḥammad&#x27;s Revelation</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p121">121–130</a></div>

<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">People reject the Day of Resurrection that has already come</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p124">124</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">&#x27;Ye must be born again&#x27;: spiritual birth in every Dispensation</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p125">125</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">&#x27;Let the dead bury their dead&#x27;</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p126">126</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">&#x27;Alí and the contract between two &#x27;dead&#x27; men</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p127">127</a></div>

<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">People still look to unworthy leaders for answers</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p130">130</a></div>

<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Earthly dominion would not be true even of God</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p133">133</a></div>

<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">The immortality and self-sacrifice of these holy souls</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p139">139</a></div>

<div class="ol-row ol-l1"><span class="ol-text">Closing the theme with the &#x27;Abode of Peace&#x27;</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p188">188</a></div>

<div class="ol-row ol-l1"><span class="ol-text">Countless mysteries yet unrevealed</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p190">190</a></div>

<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Divergent utterances explained by differing stations</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p192">192–193, 195</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Divinity from the standpoint of oneness</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p193">193</a></div>

<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">The breeze of God wafted in this day</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p197">197</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l1"><span class="ol-text">Seeking understanding rather than rejecting holy words</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p199">199–202</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Muḥammad derided for His answers on the new moons and the Spirit</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p200">200–201</a></div>

<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Sciences claimed as prerequisites for understanding the Mi&#x27;ráj</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p203">203–204</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">The &#x27;veil of knowledge&#x27; consumed by love</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p205">205</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Vain pretensions and the people&#x27;s allegiance to him</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p206">206–207</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Challenge to prove his alchemy; Bahá&#x27;u&#x27;lláh&#x27;s sufferings</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p208">208</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Described in the Qur&#x27;án as &#x27;Athím&#x27;</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p209">209–210</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l1"><span class="ol-text">Divine knowledge from pure hearts and the illumined</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p211">211–212</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l1"><span class="ol-text">Conditions of the true seeker</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p213">213–215</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Cleansing the heart of acquired knowledge, love and hate</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p213">213</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Detachment, humility and guarding the tongue</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p213">213</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Shunning backbiting; contentment, prayer, kindness and forgiveness</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p214">214</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Uncertainty of one&#x27;s own end</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p214">214</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">&#x27;Whoso maketh efforts for Us&#x27;</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p215">215</a></div>

<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Renewed once in about a thousand years</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p218">218</a></div>

<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Rejecting the Qur&#x27;án means rejecting earlier Scriptures</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p225">225</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l1"><span class="ol-text">Qur&#x27;ánic verses that make revealed verses the supreme proof</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p226">226–231</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">&#x27;Produce a Súrah like it&#x27;: verses as the sun among proofs</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p226">226–227</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">&#x27;In what revelation will they believe&#x27;: no greater testimony</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p228">228</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Warnings to those who disdain and ridicule the verses</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p229">229–230</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Demands for miracles; the sun as proof of itself</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p230">230</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">&#x27;Bring back our fathers&#x27;: foolish demands of the scoffers</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p231">231</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l1"><span class="ol-text">The verses as a testimony even to the common people</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p232">232–233</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">A claim of the learned refuted as pride and love of authority</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p232">232–233</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Understanding depends on purity of heart, not learning</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p233">233</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l1"><span class="ol-text">Revelation dismissed as poetry, old tales and forgery</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p234">234–235</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">The same charges made against the present Revelation</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p235">235</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l1"><span class="ol-text">The claim that no Prophet would come after the last</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p236">236–238</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">The verse of Joseph: &#x27;God will by no means raise up a Messenger&#x27;</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p236">236</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Christian divines and the permanence of the Gospel law</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p236">236</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">&#x27;Seal of the Prophets&#x27; as a veil; interpretation known only to the well-grounded</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p237">237</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">&#x27;Whom God causeth to err through a knowledge&#x27; applied to the divines</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p237">237–238</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l1"><span class="ol-text">Slanders against the Manifestations and the flood of new verses</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p239">239–241</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Prophets called calumniators, misleaders and madmen</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p239">239</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Present attacks and the countless verses of this Revelation</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p240">240</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Call to meditate on His Word and submit to His Cause</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p241">241</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l1"><span class="ol-text">&#x27;Do ye not disavow us&#x27;: the early Muslims&#x27; faith in the verses</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p242">242–243</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Persecution of Muḥammad&#x27;s companions for believing the verses</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p242">242</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Those who accept the new verses must be true believers</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p243">243</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l1"><span class="ol-text">The verses as the only standard for recognizing Manifestations</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p244">244–245</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">&#x27;A Book written on parchment&#x27; and the charge of sorcery</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p244">244</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">No excuse for rejecting verses revealed without learning</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p245">245</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l1"><span class="ol-text">Proof from the faith and sacrifice of the Báb&#x27;s followers</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p246">246–256</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">In past ages the lowly believed while the learned scorned</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p246">246</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Learned divines who embraced this Revelation, with names</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p247">247–248</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Their martyrdom and detachment as testimony</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p249">249–250</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Their sufferings compared with those of the &#x27;Prince of Martyrs&#x27;</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p251">251</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">&#x27;Wish for death&#x27;: the Book&#x27;s touchstone of sincerity</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p252">252–253</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">&#x27;O Son of Man!&#x27;: a call to rise from slumber</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p254">254</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">None of the believing divines were leaders of religion</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p255">255–256</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">The Báb&#x27;s epistle to the divines as a warning to the people of the Bayán</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p256">256</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l1"><span class="ol-text">Proof from the Báb&#x27;s constancy in proclaiming the Cause</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p257">257–262</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">A youth proclaiming, without fear, a Cause all opposed</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p257">257</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">His longing for martyrdom in the Qayyúmu&#x27;l-Asmá&#x27; and the commentary on &#x27;Há&#x27;&#x27;</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p258">258–260</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">The ingratitude and slanders of this generation</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p260">260</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Steadfastness as proof: &#x27;Two verses have made Me old&#x27;</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p261">261</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">His fervor growing under persecution until His martyrdom</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p262">262</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l1"><span class="ol-text">Proof from His ascendancy and transforming influence</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p263">263–264</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Signs of His power in every city after &#x27;the year sixty&#x27; in Shíráz</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p263">263</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">The radiant resignation of the persecuted believers</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p263">263–264</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l1"><span class="ol-text">The world&#x27;s denunciation itself as proof of truth</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p265">265</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l1"><span class="ol-text">Traditions foretelling the Revelation and its rejection</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p266">266–275</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Why a few traditions are cited</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p266">266</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">&#x27;The people of both the East and the West curse it&#x27;</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p267">267</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Opposition caused by the annulment of customs and rules</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p267">267–268</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">People waiting for a Promised One who upholds the old Law</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p268">268</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Traditions of a new law and a new Book from a Youth of Baní-Háshim</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p269">269–271</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Divines foretold as His chief enemies</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p270">270–271</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">&#x27;Knowledge is twenty and seven letters&#x27;</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p272">272</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">The Tablet of Fáṭimih: sufferings of the Qá&#x27;im&#x27;s chosen ones</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p273">273</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Zawrá&#x27; and the martyrs slain in Rayy</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p274">274–275</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">The divines of that age as the most wicked beneath heaven</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p275">275</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l1"><span class="ol-text">Bahá&#x27;u&#x27;lláh&#x27;s warning to the learned of the Bayán</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p276">276–277</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Opposition foreseen in the day of Mustagháth</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p276">276</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Unprecedented jealousy and betrayal by professed friends</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p277">277</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l1"><span class="ol-text">Bahá&#x27;u&#x27;lláh&#x27;s withdrawal to the wilderness and return</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p278">278–279</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Two years of solitude to avoid discord among the faithful</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p278">278</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Return in submission to the divine summons; enemies&#x27; plots</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p278">278–279</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">His readiness to give His life for the Primal Point</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p279">279</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l1"><span class="ol-text">Rejection despite verses and fulfilled traditions</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p280">280–282</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">The people cling to the letter of misunderstood traditions</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p280">280</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">&#x27;In the year sixty, His Cause shall be made manifest&#x27;</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p281">281</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Four signs from four Prophets in the Qá&#x27;im</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p282">282</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l1"><span class="ol-text">The twofold language of the Manifestations</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p283">283–285</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Plain speech to guide and veiled speech to test</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p283">283</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">&#x27;Seventy meanings&#x27; and the Qá&#x27;im&#x27;s unveiling of them</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p283">283</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">Blame unfulfilled traditions on lack of understanding; seek the Expounders</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p284">284</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l2"><span class="ol-text">None sincerely seek the guidance of the Manifestations</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p285">285</a></div>
<div class="ol-row ol-l1"><span class="ol-text">Closing verses on turning from God&#x27;s remembrance</span><a class="ol-ref" href="read.html#p286">286–287</a></div>
